Preemptively framing all domestic criticism and independent monitoring as foreign subversion shields the regime from accountability.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing WHAT (protecting electoral integrity) with WHO (who controls the ballot), masking state authoritarianism behind externalized blame.

Social Physics Analysis:
The Kremlin runs a classic Smart Selfish Maneuver, inventing external threats to project blame onto the West while dismantling internal democratic checks.

When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Deception. Unfounded pretexts mask autocratic consolidation.

The Unavoidable Lie: State-managed sham elections are defended as targets of Western subversion.
